items.title: 67246_Buck Clayton oral history interview
items.q: I made it in Europe, Panassie. Yes, for Panassie... So we made a little tour over there

ctx.x: When did you make 'West End Blues'?
I made it in Europe, Panassie. Yes, for Panassie. But I know he made 'Fiesta in Blue'.
I think he made it with Benny wasn't it?
